verdict.rationale: Numeral publishes a dated, versioned API reference (v2026-03-01) with a changelog and documented endpoints for products, calculations, transactions, refunds, refund reversals, merchants, platform calculations, exemption certificates and an authenticated ping. A quickstart walks through TEST API keys and POST calls, and the docs expose an llms.txt index that agents can read. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
